newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Paranagua/Santos sugar shipping conditions.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Paranagua/Santos sugar shipping conditions.

text.p: The Brazilian port of Paranagua reported the following conditions for shipping sugar.

Vessels: Ocean Transport loading 25,000 tonnes bulk sugar, Elena III loading 24,000 tonnes bulk sugar, Trust loading 25,000 tonnes bulk sugar, Anteos loading 14,000 bagged sugar (big bags) Waiting to dock: five vessels to load bagged sugar, one to load bagged sugar
Road: 241 trucks carrying sugar arrived on August 14
Loaded (August 14): 1,673 tonnes bagged sugar, 3,515 tonnes bulk sugar

Vessels: Tia Angelica loading 12,250 tonnes bagged sugar, Maro loading 13,000 tonnes bagged sugar, Valentin Khutorsk loading 12,500 tonnes bagged sugar, Libanus, Global Star, Phaeton and Janbaz all loading 14,000 tonnes bagges sugar each, Pantaziz L loading 25,000 tonnes bulk sugar
Waiting to dock: 10 vessels to bagged sugar (five of which are waiting for sugar to arrive in port), three vessels to load bulk sugar (all awaiting sugar)
Stocks: 30,846 tonnes bulk in CODESP warehouses. Private warehouses contain bagged sugar but stock levels unavailable
